about.title: Our history and values
about.p1: School No. 20 was founded in 1978 and has since raised thousands of graduates. Today our school is equipped with modern educational technology: interactive classrooms, STEM labs, a sports hall and a library.
about.p2: Our main goal is to unlock the potential of every student and raise independent, responsible and knowledgeable individuals.
about.mission: To give every student the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in the modern world.
about.vision: To become the most advanced and innovative educational institution in the region.

timeline.text: The school was founded and its first students were admitted.
Computer classrooms opened and informatics was introduced.
The school was fully renovated and a new sports hall was built.
STEM labs and a robotics club were launched.
A digital learning platform and international partnership programs were introduced.

news.title: The latest from school life
news.subtitle: Be the first to know about olympiads, events and important changes at our school.

items.title: Our students won the national robotics olympiad
items.excerpt: Our team won 2 gold and 1 silver medals at the National Robotics Olympiad.
body: Team No. 20 delivered a brilliant performance at the National Robotics Olympiad. The team, made up of students from grades 3 to 11, took first place in two categories.
Our students spent three months designing, programming and testing their robots. The jury highly praised their technical solutions.
The school administration congratulated the winners and announced plans to take part in international competitions next year.

items.title: A new STEM laboratory has opened
items.excerpt: A laboratory fully equipped with modern instruments for physics, chemistry and biology is now in operation.
body: The new STEM laboratory has opened its doors for our students. It is fully equipped with everything needed for modern hands-on experiments in physics, chemistry and biology.
The upgraded lab features 3D printers, microscopes and interactive whiteboards. Students can now put their theoretical knowledge into practice.
At the opening ceremony, students presented the scientific projects they had prepared.

items.title: English immersion week took place
items.excerpt: For a whole week students took part in debates, quizzes and creative competitions in English.
body: English immersion week at School No. 20 was a great success. Throughout the week students joined speech contests, debates and quizzes held entirely in English.
On the final day, students performed theatrical sketches in English. The most active participants received special certificates.
Our foreign language teachers announced that this event will now become a tradition held every academic year.

items.title: Graduation Day — 2026
items.excerpt: This year's graduates scored high on international exams and gained admission to prestigious universities.
body: Graduation Day was a solemn and moving occasion for School No. 20. This year 120 graduates successfully completed school and stepped into a new chapter of life.
Many of our graduates earned high scores on international exams and were admitted to the republic's most prestigious universities.
At the ceremony, graduates prepared a concert program for their teachers and left their mark in the school's history.

items.title: Chess club takes 1st place at the city championship
items.excerpt: Our chess club members won first place in the team standings of the city championship.
body: Members of School No. 20's chess club took part in the city schools championship and won first place in the team standings.
Twenty-four school teams competed. Our students' consistent play earned them the title.
The club leader noted that this achievement came from the students' hard work and expects even better results at future competitions.

items.title: "Green Spring" eco campaign
items.excerpt: Students planted more than 200 trees and shrubs around the school grounds.
body: As part of the "Green Spring" eco campaign, School No. 20 students planted more than 200 trees and shrubs around the school grounds.
All classes took part. Students greened their own areas, making our school even more beautiful.
The eco campaign will now become a tradition held every spring.
